what_i_see: A Calder-esque abstract sculpture with a thick gray cylindrical pedestal base, a tilted red rectangular plane intersecting the top, and several thin vertical rods of varying heights sprouting upward topped with colorful spheres (blue, yellow, red) plus a central white cylinder. An orange sphere nestles behind the red plane. The composition has a kinetic-mobile quality with good use of primary colors against a dark background.
